Per-crystal CONN AFE setup (xtal_hz = 24/25/26/40 MHz): CONN_AFE_XTALCNT 0x7c0030f4 = two crystal-cycle counts (50.5 and 30.3 x f_MHz); CONN_AFE_XTALMODE 0x7c003004 [1:0]/[7:6] = 2/1 for 24 AND 40 MHz (3/3 for 25, 3/1 for 26), [3:2] = [17:16] = 3. Identical codes for 24 and 40 MHz: crystal-type settings, not PLL ratios; no clock divider here (notes/07). HAZARD: never write these.
CONN AFE init pulse sequence on 0x7c003000/04/08 bits (reset/enable steps with delays).
Fills the module interface array DLM 0x02014f04 + 4*module (0x5c modules): base addresses and field tables per module (notes/05, work/crmap).
Fills the GCI accessor table DLM 0x02013800..0x0201388c (MT7996 'FIT').
Set(selector, value): one read-modify-write (accessor +0x0c). Selector = module<<16 | group<<5 | field.
Varargs pairs (n, sel, val, ...): one read-modify-write per pair (accessor +0x20, MT7996 non-transaction setter).
MAC IFS setter: type 0 = slot, 1 = SIFS, 2 = RIFS, 3 = EIFS.
MAC IFS init (called from RAM macIfsInit).
Low-power timers 0x820b00a4 [11:0], 0x820b00c0..d4 from a config struct.
Bank configuration word: 2 KiB banks, [31] page size (PLE 0 = 64 B, PSE 0 = 128 B).
(ple, pse, icap) positions of the PLE / PSE / ICAP partitions (must differ); MT7996's PLE/PSE/ICAP partition. ICAP mode uses (1, 2, 0).

ICAP_CR10 [18] setter (MT7996 packer 24 -> 32); never called by the RAM firmware.
A-die RF register read (reg, path). Callable through fwdbg: call 0x83a662 reg path.
A-die RF register write (reg, value, path). HAZARD: never RF 0xbc, 0x21c, 0xcc4, 0xd20, 0xce0 (power, PLL, VCO calibration).
ROM RF/calibration API (via *0x008229c4): runtime op table *0x0201456c (notes/04).
RF synthesizer programming: LO words RF 0xc68/0xca8 (integer [29:20], 18-bit fraction [19:2], about 114 Hz per LSB at 2.4 GHz) (notes/04).
Clears the per-chain calibration result words (0x830076xx/78xx, 0x8300axxx).
ROM PHY_BN_MODE writer: [27:24] = {0,1,2}[a0] else 3, [30:28] = a1 (band). Only callers are calibrations passing a0 = 1/2/3 and a1 = band, so the ROM has no narrow code either (notes/07).
Calibration that writes PHY_BN_MODE [27:24] = 0/1/2 with step counts 4/6/10.
PHY power-on per band: PHY_BN_MODE [30:28] = band, 0x830a3008 |= 0x8c0000, 0x830a3024 |= 0xc0000; 2026 patch twin at 0x906050.
PHY_BN_CTRL 0x83080000 [5:4] = {0,1,2}[x] (table 0x850768): x is the chain index.
Calibration step: PHY_BN_CLKFORCE0/1 |= 0xffffff (all band clocks forced on).
ROM twin of RAM txToneStart, for 4 chains.
Calibration (path): 0x7c003014 [6:3] = 8 >> path, PHY_RXFE_CTRL |= 3, then a reset pulse on the chain's 0x8300e00c word.
Calibration helper; passes the path as the chain index (also its x0x10000 offset).
Registers the AXI_DMA0..3 interrupt handlers and resets the per-channel callbacks.
(ch, 0): start and wait up to 1000 ticks for completion; (ch, 1): stop.

Configures a channel from a cfg struct: ADDR0 = cfg[1], ADDR1 = cfg[2], LEN = cfg[3]; mode from cfg[8,10,12,13,15] selects which control fields go into AXI_DMAn_CTRL ([29:28] cfg[6], [25:24] cfg[7], [20] cfg[8], [18:16] cfg[9], [15] cfg[10], [14:5] cfg[11], [0] cfg[14]); callback cfg[17]. A store to a PHY register costs 238 ns on the bus, so no DMA can feed a 10 Msps DAC (notes/07).
Allocates a free channel from a per-class bitmap (0xdeaddead = none).
